args.sql:
SELECT o.opsregistry, t.totaldeliverytons, d.hubcaptons, t.deliverysuccessrate, t.vehiclebreakrate, 
  (t.totaldeliverytons / d.hubcaptons) AS ratio,
  (t.totaldeliverytons / d.hubcaptons) * t.deliverysuccessrate * (1 - t.vehiclebreakrate/100.0) * 100 AS lpm_score
FROM operations o 
JOIN transportation t ON o.opshubref = t.transporthubref 
JOIN distributionhubs d ON o.opshubref = d.hubregistry
ORDER BY lpm_score LIMIT 10;

  COUNT(*) AS total,
  COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE lpm_score > 90) AS above_90,

FROM (
  SELECT o.opsregistry,

  FROM operations o 
  JOIN transportation t ON o.opshubref = t.transporthubref 
  JOIN distributionhubs d ON o.opshubref = d.hubregistry
) sub;

  WHEN lpm_score > 90 THEN 'Completed'
  WHEN lpm_score BETWEEN 40 AND 90 THEN 'Scaling Down'
  ELSE 'Active'
END

    (t.totaldeliverytons / d.hubcaptons) * t.deliverysuccessrate * (1 - t.vehiclebreakrate/100.0) AS lpm_score
  FROM operations o2 
  JOIN transportation t ON o2.opshubref = t.transporthubref 
  JOIN distributionhubs d ON o2.opshubref = d.hubregistry
) sub
WHERE o.opsregistry = sub.opsregistry;
